text:
anya: quick check on microcopy for the editor close flow. noticed the toast says `Unsaved changes` but the modal reads `You have unsaved changes. Discard?` feels inconsistent. sam: good catch. propose we make toast informational and modal decisive. toast: `You have unsaved changes` modal title: `Unsaved changes` body: `You have unsaved changes. Save or discard before closing.` buttons: `Save` (primary), `Discard changes` (destructive), `Keep editing` (secondary). marta: +1. tiny copy nit: `Keep editing` > `Cancel` for clarity, especially for screen reader users. Also prefer `Discard changes` rather than just `Discard`. des: visual/button pattern note: our design tokens put primary on the right. keep that (Save on right), destructive left and red, keep keyboard order matching visual order. add visible focus ring for the destructive button. liam: a11y notes: - toast should be in an aria-live="polite" region (non-blocking). - modal should trap focus and set initial focus to the title. - add aria-describedby from buttons to body if labels are terse. anya: ok locking the exact copy so I can update Figma/copy repo. draft final: - toast (short): `You have unsaved changes` - toast with CTA: `You have unsaved changes 14 Save now` (CTA label `Save`) - modal title: `Unsaved changes` - modal body: `You have unsaved changes. Save your changes or discard them. Unsaved changes will be lost.` - actions: `Save` (primary), `Discard changes` (destructive), `Keep editing` (secondary) marta: small alternative for body that reads a bit friendlier: `You have unsaved changes. Save your work or discard it; unsaved changes will be lost.` des: either works. prefer the first for brevity. i'll also make sure the destructive button has explicit aria-label `Discard changes (this cannot be undone)` for screen reader clarity. liam: code snippet for devs to follow: ```
You have unsaved changes

Unsaved changes

You have unsaved changes. Unsaved changes will be lost.
``` anya: also note autosave variant: if autosave enabled -> toast `All changes saved` (success) and modal should just show `All changes are saved` with a single `Close` button. i'll add both variants in Figma. ux-bot: Reference: https://docs.redwood.design/button-patterns (Primary right, destructive left, secondary ghost). marta: i'll run NVDA + VoiceOver test once this lands. des: i'll cover keyboard + visual QA. anya: thanks team 14 i'll update the master copy file and push the Figma changes in the next editor patch. :rocket:
